profile.headline: Principal Engineer with 30 years’ experience, mostly front-end
profile.summary: I’m an engineering manager and principal full-stack developer with 27 years’ experience building websites, web applications, component libraries and design systems. I’m looking for new management roles where I can help a talented engineering team shine. I also still love to write code, and I am happily open to principal, senior, and architect level developer roles.

positions.title: Deputy Director of Web Development
positions.description: Skills: Team Leadership · Team Management · Business Development · People Management

positions.title: Senior Engineer L2
positions.description:
Front-end team lead and architect: manage front-end developers, design code architecture, conduct code reviews, team and resource management for front-end projects, collaboration with delivery, QA, creative, UX, strategy, SEO. Examples include http://heforshe.org http://www.sapientrazorfish.com
Advanced HTML/CSS/Javascript programming, focus on animations, CMS-driven corporate sites.
